title: Center of Mass and Linear Momentum

questions.q: A mass $m$ moving with speed $v$ collides inelastically with an identical mass $m$ at rest, and they stick together. What fraction of the kinetic energy is lost?
questions.e: The final speed is $v/2$ and the energy is $\tfrac12(2m)(v/2)^2=\tfrac14mv^2$, so half remains.

questions.q: A ball of mass $m$ moving with speed $v$ makes a head-on elastic collision with a ball of mass $3m$ at rest. The velocity of the first ball afterwards is
How far from the center of the circle is the center of mass of a thin uniform wire bent into a semicircle of radius $R$?
questions.e: $y_c=\dfrac1{\pi R}\int_0^\pi R\sin\theta\,R\,d\theta=2R/\pi$. ($4R/3\pi$ is the result for a half-disk.)

A 60 kg person stands in a 240 kg boat (no water resistance). If the person walks 5 m relative to the boat, how far does the boat move relative to the water?
questions.e: The center of mass stays in place: $60(5-x)=240x\Rightarrow x=1$ m.
